rationale: Builds on the winning staged reverse-tail recurrence setup by adding a compact anchor-refresh curriculum inside the recurrent tail. Early training keeps the decoder-output anchor fixed; later stages gradually let deeper recurrent passes refresh that anchor, aiming to preserve the strong fixed-anchor behavior while improving late-tail reuse at the exact final eval profile. The edit is structural, compile-stable, byte-neutral, and avoids another low-value scalar-only sweep.
title: Staged Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh Curriculum
